title: Detect level-up eligibility
description: Pure eligibility check: given current XP/milestone state and the campaign advancement policy, compute whether a character is eligible to level up and to what target level. Read-only — does not mutate or apply. Drives prompts and the guided flow.
acceptance_criteria: Given state + policy, returns eligible target level (or none); covers XP-threshold crossing and milestone modes; multi-level catch-up is handled explicitly; unit tests cover boundaries.
notes: Eligibility detection in levelUpEligibility.ts (getLevelUpEligibility + pure helpers). XP threshold crossing + multi-level catch-up; milestone outstanding/consumed via ledger. PR #339 open. 9 tests; full verify green.
